title: EG&G engineer's account of an egg-shaped craft that could not be opened

tellings.quote: The senior EG&G engineer described to my great uncle that it was egg-shaped about the size of a SUV.

plain: A senior engineer at EG&G, a defense contractor, is said to have described a craft that was egg-shaped, about the size of an SUV, and could not be opened. Michels tells it as something the engineer described to his own great-uncle, so it reaches us secondhand through his family. If true, it would mean people inside the defense industry had handled an unknown craft they could not get into.
